subject: Purchase authorization map, CLA owners, and redline takt
body:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medsys.com>, Sophie Tremblay <sophie.t@medsys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Purchase authorization map, CLA owners, and redline takt

Hi Liam / Sophie —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the pilot procurement path:

- Goal: 6-week pilot for inference on a dedicated capacity lane (MedSys telemetry workload).
- Primary decision criteria you called out: latency SLO (95th percentile < 250ms), data residency in us-east, and ability to export audit logs monthly.
- Immediate blockers: internal CLA/MSA owner alignment and procurement scheduling (month-end closers at MedSys).

My asks:
1) Can you confirm who owns vendor contracts (CLA/MSA) vs. the DPA/security artifact at MedSys?
2) If procurement needs a signed NDA before sharing the test dataset, we can prioritize that week-of-4/11.

Ben / Neha / Lauren — internal owners copied to help map signoff lanes and expected turn-times so Liam and Sophie have a single-response playbook.

Attachments: Procurement_Timeline_v2.pdf (timeline + typical turn times), CLA_signer_matrix.xlsx (starter mapping), MSA_redline_v1.docx (our suggested minimal edits).

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0182

--
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medsys.com>, Sophie Tremblay <sophie.t@medsys.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Purchase authorization map, CLA owners, and redline takt

Thanks Hannah — nice recap. A few quick clarifications from the commercial side:

- Economic buyer: Liam, you mentioned Sarah Patel (VP of Engineering) as the primary econ buyer for pilot spend approval. Can you confirm her email so we can loop her on commercial terms?
- Commercial cadence: our standard approach is "pilot PO + MSA signature". If MedSys requires a separate CLA (company-level agreement), we can treat that as a parallel sign-off not blocking pilot start, provided an NDA is in place.

Operational ask for MedSys: if you can flag the internal approvers for PO vs. MSA vs. Security (DPA) we’ll map the fastest path. Typical turn-times we see: 
- NDA: 2–4 business days
- Pilot PO (approved by econ buyer + procurement): 5–10 business days after PO submission
- MSA redline cycle: 3–7 business days for initial comments, longer if exec legal gets involved.

Ben Carter
Lead Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

--
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medsys.com>
Cc: Sophie Tremblay <sophie.t@medsys.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Purchase authorization map, CLA owners, and redline takt

Liam / Sophie — quick security note from our side:

- DPA artifacts: MedSys will need the DPA and a brief SOC 2 scope statement; we can provide a SOC 2 summary and an audit contact within 24 hours of request.
- Data handling: for the pilot we recommend a scoped dataset with synthetic identifiers; that will accelerate internal security sign-off.

If MedSys security wants to do a short 30-minute call to validate the dataset and logging, we can make time next week (dates available 4/12–4/16).

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

--
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medsys.com>, procurement@medsys.com
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 11:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Purchase authorization map, CLA owners, and redline takt

Hi Liam / procurement team —

Thanks for working with us on timing. To make the procurement lane explicit, please see the quick owner map below: 

- NDA: Legal Ops (point: Sophie Tremblay) — target 3 business days.
- Pilot PO: Procurement (point: procurement@medsys.com) + Econ buyer (Sarah Patel) — target 5 business days once PO submitted.
- MSA: Legal (executive legal if redlines > 3 clauses) — target 3–7 business days for initial redline exchange.
- DPA: Security team (point: Liam O'Connor) — target 4 business days for approval after DPA draft.

I attached a CLA_signer_matrix.xlsx that lists suggested signers on our side and a lightweight PO template to speed procurement submission. If you prefer, we can convert the MSA redline into track-changes and drop into DocuSign for signature routing.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Customer Operations | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

Attachments: CLA_signer_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

--
From: Sophie Tremblay <sophie.t@medsys.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Purchase authorization map, CLA owners, and redline takt

Thanks everyone — useful mapping. Quick confirmations on MedSys side:

- CLA / MSA owner: Legal Ops (me) will own the MSA redline and CLA signoff; please send redlines to legal@medsys.com and I’ll triage.
- Econ buyer: Sarah Patel (sarah.patel@medsys.com) — she’ll review the PO once procurement raises it.
- Procurement cadence: procurement@medsys.com is our PO intake; they do weekly PO reviews on Wednesday mornings (so timing matters).
- NDA: we can sign a mutual NDA within 48 hours if you send a clean copy.

Action items I’ll take: schedule internal approval touchpoint next Tues to confirm Sarah’s availability for PO signoff.

Sophie Tremblay
Legal Operations | MedSys Health
sophie.t@medsys.com

---
Next steps (agreed):
- Hannah to send a clean mutual NDA by 4/09 EOD so Sophie can route (ACTION: Hannah).
- Ben to draft pilot commercial term sheet and send to Sarah + procurement by 4/12 (ACTION: Ben).
- Neha to prepare SOC 2 summary + dataset handling note by 4/11 (ACTION: Neha).
- Lauren to enable a DocuSign MSA track-changes option if MedSys legal prefers that flow (ACTION: Lauren).

[Attachment stubs in thread: Procurement_Timeline_v2.pdf (pdf), MSA_redline_v1.docx (docx), CLA_signer_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)]
